verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python library/framework whose entire surface is a documented, typed public API (Agent class, tools, output types, message history, MCP client, CLI, model providers) with extensive first-party docs and community corroboration of real-world programmatic use. missing for 10: independent third-party API reference/spec beyond vendor docs, and no evidence of a formal versioned API stability guarantee or changelog for the public API surface.
